implemented: Provider-neutral, additive visual request/result port with explicit image formats, scope epochs, cancellation, deadline and egress metadata. The default runtime is unconfigured and cannot enable a camera.

Ephemeral explicit session camera lease, one-use clock challenge, conservative capture-time mapping, audience/source revision invalidation, stop/expiry release callback, bounded rate/size/queue/deadline admission and buffer disposal. Cancelled providers retain the one model slot until settlement or a finite retirement grace; non-settling adapters are quarantined and all queued sessions drained.

Trusted VisualInputHost seam derives scope and source from host callbacks, checks exact binary-part identity, applies scoped idempotent camera commands, and reports unconfigured providers as unavailable. It is not attached to an HTTP route or physical camera broker.
Deterministic fixture adapter and synthetic component tests; fixture descriptions do not derive from image pixels.
